reference_model.name: Frozen validated nested sequential global model
reference_model.note: Frozen prior benchmark. The local v1 reproduction is reported separately and is not silently substituted for this result.

cohort.primary_rule: Lots 1-9 are the benchmark cohort to match the frozen validated reference.

mean_model.role: Local reproducible nested robust active-sensor + sequential adaptation model

oes_candidate_ablation.warning: The six-wavelength cache came from prior exploratory screening. Selection inside each outer fold is train-only, but this is not a de-novo 3648-channel nested wavelength search. OES is therefore not used in the primary model.

early_vm.mode: cold process-only; current wafer metrology not used

spatial.policy: PCA spatial-basis is predeclared as the primary spatial model. Direct point HGB is a challenger only, avoiding post-hoc winner selection.

data_quality.preox_note: Preox is available before etch, but the provided 89-point field contains interpolated values from the original sparse pre-oxide measurement; it is not treated as 89 independent direct measurements.

notes.nominal_recipe_reference: This dataset contains essentially one BOSCH recipe. The displayed nominal recipe reference is the training-lot mean reference, not a learned multi-recipe response surface.
notes.lot_metadata: Lot/date/conditioning context is read from Lot_status.xlsx. Numeric Lot ID is not used as a continuous predictor.
notes.conditioning: Conditioning Type metadata is displayed for context but is not used as a primary predictive feature because most Type combinations occur in only one Lot and are confounded with Lot/date.
notes.oes: The six-wavelength cache came from prior exploratory screening. Selection inside each outer fold is train-only, but this is not a de-novo 3648-channel nested wavelength search. OES is therefore not used in the primary model.
notes.diagnostics: Review evidence is statistical evidence, not calibrated causal probability.
notes.operational: Primary VM uses full post-process Process traces, so it is post-process/pre-metrology. Early VM results separately quantify 25/50/75/100% cold prediction performance.
